name: ContextMatrix
summary: Values compared across contexts (light, dark, more contrast): each row's name once at the start edge, each context column rendered in its own context so a value sits on its true surface. Narrower than its columns, it scrolls sideways inside its own region with the names held; the page never does. Code in a cell stays whole. Not for a value that is the same in every context (say it once instead) or for facts with no context (use DataTable).
a11y: A native `table` with column and row headers inside a region named by `label`; the region is focusable only so keyboard users can scroll it.

keys.action: moves to the matrix's scroll region
scroll the contexts sideways while its region has focus
